name: je-social-contributions
description: Jersey social security contributions for 2026, covering ordinary monthly Class 1 employee and employer contributions, earnings thresholds and caps, Class 2 registration and assessment, and long-term care collection. Use for Jersey social security, self-employed contributions, minimum earnings, startup contributions or the upper earnings limit. Includes selected earnings, absence, accommodation, tips, leaving-payment and earnings-rounding rules. Explains why Class 2 and long-term care need separate inputs. Exemptions, credits, mixed employment, monetary rounding and complete non-monthly treatment require further checks. This source-cited draft awaits professional review; complete operational contribution outputs remain unfinished.
